question: The Sun Temple of Konark is located on the shore of the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is the **__Bay of Bengal__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On the shores of the Bay of Bengal, the temple at Konark was built in the 13th century.
 
• Konark Sun Temple, located in the **East Odisha** near the sacred **city of Puri**.
 
• Built in the 13th year by King Narasimha I (AD 1238-1264).<
